functions.name: LoadingModal
params:
{
  open,
  state = 'loading',
  title,
  message,
  stage,
  percent = -1,
  cancelable = false,
  errorMessage,
  autoCloseMs = 1200,
  onCancel,
  onClose,
  onRetry,
}

callGraph.callee: BUILTIN_TEMPLATES.filter((t) => filter === '全部' || filter === '系统内置' || t.type === filter).map

mockNovels
    .map((n) => normalizeNovel({
      ...n,
      totalWordCount: n.totalWords ?? n.totalWordCount,
      targetWordCount: n.targetWords ?? n.targetWordCount,
    }))
    .filter

Object.entries(raw as Record<string, unknown>)
      .filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined && value !== null)
      .map

        fieldValue(item, ['content', 'description'], '（空）'),
        fieldValue(item, ['limits']) ? `限制条件：${fieldValue(item, ['limits'])}` : '',

[
      `来源：设定库 AI 推演候选`,
      `类型：${typeLabels[record.suggestionType]}`,

aiTaskService.create('setting_suggestion_generate', {
      novelId: input.novelId,
      runtimeMode: settings.runtimeMode,
      provider: settings.provider,
      modelName: settings.runtimeMode === 'mock' ? 'Mock' : settings.modelName,
